articles.summary: The stock jumped after the staffing company’s results beat expectations at the top and bottom lines and flagged an improvement in trends. Shares in peer Adecco also climbed.

articles.title: Randstad shares jump 19% to over one-year high after Q3 profit beats estimates
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Randstad NV (AS:RAND) shares hit their highest level in more than a year on Wednesday after the staffing company reported third-quarter adjusted EBIT of €211 million, beating analyst consensus of €200 million by 5%, as organic revenue growth accelerated beyond expectations.

articles.title: Hays shares slide 6% as recruiter flags no near-term recovery
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Hays shares fell as much as nearly 12% on Monday before paring losses to trade down 6.9%, after the British recruiter reported a 3% like-for-like decline in first-quarter net fees, as weak permanent hiring offset stable temporary and contracting demand, and warned of no near-term rebound.
